title: Add EUR context-selected OBJ lists
changes: Extend the existing static OBJ resource with four authenticated context-selected lists; preserve the original selector aliases and unchanged-pointer behavior for out-of-range low-byte selectors.
validation: Wine e140-context-obj-wine-p2emd6x4 validates nine original selector cases, all 50 source bytes with poisoned ROM, E139 projection and unchanged unrelated resources; a three-frame ordinary interpreter/native-dispatch raw/managed pair observes 50 typed reads and zero raw reads per arm with matching full state and clock.
Wine e140-context-obj-cli-wine-ufvipvnu passes production CLI create, no-write reuse, verify and one-frame startup; all 102 other resource files are identical.
limitations: Ordinary use of other selectors, per-read native attribution, other scenes, frontend save/load, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. The independent adjacent language table remains raw. No performance measurement.
